features.justification_quote: Budget accordingly; cap turn budget to bound tail cost.

features.quote: Rigged-to-fail tasks measure your rig, not the model... A model that says 'this spec is contradictory, I can't proceed' is doing the right thing and should not count as a trigger.
features.justification_quote: conflates two things: (a) does the model spiral, and (b) does the model correctly recognize an impossible/underspecified task

features.quote: "trigger rate per dollar" is a trap as your primary KPI. It rewards making failures cheaper and faster to induce, not measuring the behavior you actually care about.
features.justification_quote: A patch that makes the model fail silently faster could improve your KPI while making the model worse.

features.quote: Don't ship the trigger tasks as training data without deduping from eval, or you'll leak the benchmark.
Define 'meltdown' with stakeholders before measuring—calm honest failure must score 0, or you'll 'fix' honesty out of the model.
features.justification_quote: or you'll 'fix' honesty out of the model
